title: bromus rigens subsp. maximus
intro: Bromus rigens subsp. maximus, commonly known as prairie bromegrass, is a perennial grass species native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat a variety of health issues, including inflammation and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of prairie bromegrass include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of prairie bromegrass are responsible for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues and promoting overall well-being.
